Bibi GPT 
 登录 
 Bibi GPT 视频总结 
1 小时视频，3 分钟看完重点——AI 视频总结、思维导图、视频转文字，一键搞定 
What is BibiGPT? 
BibiGPT (originally BiliGPT, also known as AI 课代表) is an AI video and audio assistant. Paste any video, audio, podcast or upload a local file and BibiGPT generates a structured, time-stamped summary, full transcript, mind map, and an AI chat surface over the content. Founded by JimmyLv (吕立青) in 2023, served 1M+ users since. 
How does BibiGPT summarize videos? 
BibiGPT 是 AI 视频总结与音视频转文字工具：粘贴 B站（哔哩哔哩）、YouTube、抖音、小红书、 播客链接，一键完成视频总结、字幕提取、视频转文字、思维导图生成；支持 AI 对话追问、 图文改写，并可一键保存到 Notion、Obsidian、flomo 笔记。免费试用，无需下载安装。 
Which platforms does BibiGPT support? 
BibiGPT works with YouTube, Bilibili (B 站), TikTok, Douyin (抖音), Kuaishou (快手), Xiaohongshu (小红书), Twitter / X, Vimeo, TED, Coursera, Khan Academy, Apple Podcasts, Spotify, Xiaoyuzhou (小宇宙), Ximalaya (喜马拉雅), and arbitrary web pages with audio or video tags. Local files supported: mp3, mp4, m4a, wav, srt, vtt, ass. 
Is BibiGPT free? 
Free tier with daily quota (30-min videos). Plus $19.8/mo (year $142.56). Pro $34.8/mo (year $250.56) with vision, batch processing, and API access. Lifetime $888 (limited). Pay-as-you-go credits from $20 (2,000 credits) to $200 (40,000 credits, 50% off per credit). 
How do AI agents integrate with BibiGPT? 
Four agent surfaces: (1) MCP server at https://bibigpt.co/api/mcp with OAuth 2.0 + Bearer; (2) REST OpenAPI spec at https://bibigpt.co/api/openapi.json; (3) NLWeb /ask endpoint with SSE streaming at https://bibigpt.co/api/ask; (4) Anthropic Skill via npx skills add JimmyLv/bibigpt-skill . Discovery files: /.well-known/agent-card.json (A2A), /.well-known/mcp.json, /llms.txt, /api/llms.txt, /pricing.md, /index.md. Try /api/discover for a single-call list of all agent entry points, or visit https://bibigpt.co/?mode=agent for a structured JSON view of this homepage. 
How does BibiGPT handle privacy? 
Uploaded files auto-deleted after 30 days. Summaries default to private and only become public when the user explicitly toggles sharing. BibiGPT does not train on user content without opt-in. Full data export and delete via dashboard. GDPR / CCPA compliant. See the BibiGPT Privacy Policy and security.txt . 
Who built BibiGPT? 
Founder 吕立青 (JimmyLv) — former ThoughtWorks and Alibaba engineer — open-sourced the predecessor as BiliGPT on GitHub in 2023. Product docs: docs.bibigpt.co . Company page: About BibiGPT . Support: Contact . Legal: Terms of Service . 
Multi-platform clients 
Web app at bibigpt.co (Chinese) and aitodo.co (international). Browser extension for Chrome / Firefox / Edge. Desktop app for macOS and Windows (Tauri 2.x). Mobile apps for iOS and Android (Expo). Cross-platform agent integration via MCP / OpenAPI / Skill.

subpages.https://bibigpt.co/about:
Bibi GPT AI 音视频助理 
 更新日志 v4.749.0 
 切换语言 切换主题 注册/登录 
关于 BibiGPT 
BibiGPT 是国内最早覆盖国内外各大音视频平台的 AI 音视频知行助理。我们相信，每个人都应该能够用算力节省脑力——把 1 小时的视频压缩成 5 分钟的核心要点，把无序的会议录音变成可检索的知识库，把任意音视频内容变成可二次创作的产物。 
我们做什么 
BibiGPT（曾用名 BiliGPT、AI 课代表）让用户粘贴一个视频或音频链接，30 秒内得到带时间戳的结构化总结、全文转写、思维导图，并可以与内容多轮对话。我们覆盖 30+ 平台：B 站、YouTube、TikTok、抖音、小红书、Twitter/X、Apple Podcasts、小宇宙、TED、Coursera 等，也支持本地文件直传（mp3/mp4/m4a/wav/srt/vtt/ass）。 
进阶能力包括字幕翻译压制、视觉画面分析（看懂 PPT、白板、图表）、图文改写（把视频变成小红书图文 / 公众号文 / 推特 thread / PPT 大纲）、Notion / Obsidian 笔记联动，以及面向 AI Agent 的 MCP 服务器、OpenAPI、NLWeb /ask 端点和 Anthropic Skill。 
我们为谁服务 
 职场人 ：1 小时会议录音 → 5 分钟会议纪要 + 行动项 
 自媒体 / 内容创作者 ：视频内容一键生成多平台改写素材 
 教师 / 学生 ：网课 / 讲座的高效学习工具 
 研究者 ：从公开音视频中检索关键信息 
 企业 / 开发者 ：通过 API + MCP 接入自有 Agent 工作流 
截至 2026 年，累计服务 100 万+ 用户。 
团队 
 吕立青（JimmyLv） — 创始人。前 ThoughtWorks 工程师 → 阿里巴巴工程师 → 独立海外 SaaS 创业者。同时也是内容创作者，B 站 Up 主 + YouTuber，全网粉丝累计超过 10 万。 
项目历史： 
2023：以开源 BiliGPT 起步，社区驱动迭代 
2024：演进为 SaaS 产品 bibigpt.co 
2025：扩展浏览器插件、桌面端、移动端 
2026：发布 Agent / MCP / Skill 接入，国际化海外市场（aitodo.co） 
我们的原则 
 数据隐私第一 ：用户上传文件 30 天后自动删除；总结结果默认私有；无未经授权的训练数据使用 
 平台覆盖最广 ：尤其重视国内 B 站 / 小红书 / 抖音等海外工具无法解析的来源 
 端到端闭环 ：从知识获取到知识创作一站式 
 Agent 友好 ：第一天就把 BibiGPT 设计成可被 LLM 调用的工具，而不是事后补 API

🎬 This project summarizes YouTube/Bilibili/Twitter/TikTok/Podcast/Lecture/Meeting/... videos or audios for you using AI.
🤯 Inspired by [Nutlope/news-summarizer](https://github.com/Nutlope/news-summarizer) & [zhengbangbo/chat-simplifier](https://github.com/zhengbangbo/chat-simplifier/) & [lxfater/BilibiliSummary](https://github.com/lxfater/BilibiliSummary)

## How it works
This project uses the [AI SDK OpenAI-compatible provider](https://ai-sdk.dev/providers/openai-compatible-providers) with [Vercel Edge functions](https://vercel.com/features/edge-functions) for streaming, plus [Upstash](https://console.upstash.com/) for Redis cache and rate limiting. It fetches the content on a Bilibili video, sends it in a prompt to an OpenAI-compatible API, then streams the response back to the application.

Roam Research ✍️ Writing with your lovely cards 🧩 and beautiful theme 🎨
> My custom CSS and JavaScript extension for [Roam Research](https://roamresearch.com)

## Quick Start
Deployed via [Cloudflare Pages](https://pages.cloudflare.com/)
1. Add a `{{[[roam/js]]}}` block firstly
2. Add a **CHILD** block `/JavaScript Code Block` with this code...
```js
window.URLScriptServer = `https://styled-roam.pages.dev/`
window.styledRoamDisabledFeatures = [
  // 'CardListMode',
  // 'CardFlowMode',
  // 'TreeTableMode',
  // 'DocumentMode',
  // 'CalendarMode',
  // 'DownloadMode',
  // 'FocusMode',
]
var existing = document.getElementById('styled-roam')
if (!existing) {
  var extension = document.createElement('script')
  extension.src = window.URLScriptServer + 'js/index.js'
  extension.id = 'styled-roam'
  extension.async = true
  extension.type = 'text/javascript'
  document.getElementsByTagName('head')[0].appendChild(extension)
}
```
3. Press the **BIG RED** button to enable the script

## Getting Started

## Install dependencies & Run
```bash
npm install # properly use cnpm if you are in China
npm run dev:ng # open http://localhost:8080/
npm run dev:vue # open http://localhost:8081/
npm run dev:react # open http://localhost:8082/
```
## Deploy && CI
```bash
npm run build
git push
```
